scope: Genuine GenAI Engine MTP and --disable-mtp on the same unchanged unpruned capacity-four export. CPU-owned GenAI state, not the public GPU IOBinding loop or WebGPU.

methodology.caveat: One measured repetition after three warmups is a bounded performance check, not a statistically robust speedup qualification. Fixed ordering and external system activity limit causal attribution.
methodology.capacity_note: GenAI reserves 1023 tokens for speculative scheduling in this configuration. The initial 66-block MTP request was correctly rejected because its max_request_length was 15873, below the requested 16640 tokens; both final GenAI modes use 70 blocks.
methodology.initializer_sharing: Disabled in both modes because GenAI0.19's CPU interface cannot load shared initializers.

interpretation: Do not compare this CPU-owned GenAI target baseline directly with the pruned GPU-resident public driver. Active speculation is established by actual completed rounds and evaluated draft tokens, not model configuration alone. Token differences, if any, are retained rather than hidden.
